name: MyPlugin
description: Project + git with board versions and daughter boards, LCSC/EasyEDA parts, fab-aware DRC, V/A net sizing, array placement, Copper Paths, pours, H/V autoroute, docs, BOM/CPL, FreeCAD link.
description_full:
One toolbar button opens a hub with sixteen tools: Project & Versions (standard folders + git, board versions v1/v2 with git tags, daughter boards showing the main board's outline on a 'Main board' layer), LCSC / EasyEDA Part (footprint + symbol + 3D model by LCSC number, via easyeda2kicad), Array Place (repeated channels, live spacing), BOM + CPL Export, Fab Rules (Lion Circuits DRC), Net Setup (IPC-2221 widths, netclasses, DRC rules), Power Trace, Copper Path (wide copper that follows a net's traces, keeps clearance, refresh after dragging), Power Pours, Via Stitching (bundled ViaStitcher by weirdgyn, MIT), Autoroute H/V (Freerouting, never shrinks traces), Silk Beautify, Docs (PcbDraw drawings + renders), FreeCAD (StepUp) live link both ways without restarting either app, 3D Models for Eagle imports, and Eagle -> KiCad symbol swap with netlist check.

All output is written next to the board. Optional: Java 21 + freerouting.jar (autoroute), PcbDraw and easyeda2kicad (installed on first use), FreeCAD + KiCad StepUp (installed on first use).
